title: Main Menu
summary: Central entry point of DayPass. Every menu uses the same keys: a number opens an option, 0 goes back (or exits here), q quits DayPass and h opens the manual of the screen.

items.title: Package Profiles & Dependencies
items.description: Installs or updates the proxy (Passwall), VPN, USB tethering and network tool packages.
items.usage_tip: Run this first on a fresh router; the Proxy profile starts the Passwall wizard.

items.title: Hardware & USB Tethering Manager
items.description: Detects USB phones and modems, sets up the wan_usb DHCP client, toggles it, sets failover metrics and runs USB ModeSwitch.
items.usage_tip: Enable USB Tethering on the phone before opening this menu.

items.title: Network & Routing Configuration
items.description: Home Wi-Fi AP, guest network with QoS / SQM, LAN IP, Multi-WAN (mwan3), network info and DNS modes.
items.usage_tip: Start here when clients cannot connect or you need a second internet source.

items.title: Proxy & Tunnel Engine Manager
items.description: Transport engines (Passwall, sing-box, Xray, WireGuard, OpenVPN), nodes and subscriptions, traffic routing, routing profiles and Clean IP.
items.usage_tip: Pick the active engine first; routing, DNS and balancing follow it.

items.title: Node Balancer & Health Diagnostics
items.description: Node probing, Active/Standby (failover) and other balancing modes, probe-and-switch, node health checks and an internet connectivity check.
items.usage_tip: Switching is on demand; there is no background auto-switch daemon.

items.title: System Maintenance & Backup
items.description: Maintenance and recovery, backup and restore of engine configs, log viewer and package updates.
items.usage_tip: Take a backup before large changes.

items.title: Help & Manuals
items.usage_tip: On any other menu, h opens that screen's own manual.

items.title: Exit DayPass
items.description: Closes the DayPass session without changing anything.
items.usage_tip: Safe to use at any time.

items.title: Quit DayPass
items.description: Ends the DayPass session from any menu.
items.usage_tip: Ctrl+C does the same and restores the terminal.

items.title: Help
items.description: Opens the manual of the current screen.
items.usage_tip: Enter or 0 inside a manual returns to the screen you came from; q quits DayPass.
